title: UnderGrasp: Envelopment-Oriented Grasp Refinement for an Underactuated Gripper
summary: Underactuated grippers can form enveloping grasps through passive compliance, while the terminal pose and single width predicted by generic grasp generators do not fully capture the approach-closure process. Conventional collision filtering also struggles to distinguish harmful interference from acceptable contact. We present UnderGrasp, a post-hoc grasp refinement and evaluation framework for an underactuated gripper that reuses grasp candidates and quality priors from a frozen generator. The model jointly encodes the target, local environment, support surface, and approach-path geometry to propose diverse combinations of insertion depth, pre-grasp width, and target closing width for each candidate. These actions are ranked by combining separately predicted envelopment and interaction quality with upstream priors, balancing grasp feasibility, envelopment, and scene disturbance rather than rejecting all environmental contact. The back end is trained solely on configuration and interaction labels generated by gripper-specific simulations, without real-robot grasp labels. Real-robot experiments with an underactuated gripper show that UnderGrasp improves the overall success rate (SR) and the envelopment rate (ER) among successful grasps from 0.55/0.12 to 0.82/0.55 with AnyGrasp, and from 0.42/0.08 to 0.65/0.36 with GraspNet. In contrast, increasing the fixed insertion depth to 40 mm improves ER to 0.35 but reduces SR to 0.52, supporting the value of adaptive refinement. For trials involving target or environmental contact during approach, the conditional success rates increase from 0.36 to 0.89 and from 0.25 to 0.86, respectively, demonstrating more reliable execution under contact. AI.tldr: 针对欠驱动夹爪：通用抓取生成器只输出终点位姿与单一开口宽度，无法刻画"接近—闭合"过程，传统碰撞过滤也难以区分有害干涉与可接受接触。UnderGrasp 作为事后细化与评估框架，复用冻结生成器的候选与质量先验，输出插入深度、预抓取宽度、闭合宽度的多样化组合并排序；真机实验将成功率/包覆率从 0.55/0.12 提升至 0.82/0.55（AnyGrasp）。
AI.motivation: 通用抓取生成器为欠驱动夹爪预测的终点位姿与单一宽度不能完整描述接近—闭合过程，而欠驱动夹爪依赖被动柔顺形成包覆式抓取。此外，常规碰撞过滤无法区分有害干涉与可接受的接触，倾向于一律拒绝环境接触。
AI.method: 输入包括冻结生成器给出的抓取候选与质量先验，以及目标、局部环境、支撑面和接近路径几何。方法不修改生成器，而是在事后为每个候选提出多种"插入深度 + 预抓取宽度 + 目标闭合宽度"的组合；这些动作由单独预测的包覆质量与交互质量结合上游先验进行排序，从而在可行性、包覆程度与场景扰动之间权衡，而不是拒绝所有环境接触。后端仅在夹爪专用仿真生成的配置与交互标签上训练，不使用真机抓取标签。输出是排好序、可直接执行的抓取参数组合。

title: ProMix: Efficient Data Mixture Optimization for Robotic Imitation via Proxy-Reference DRO
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in open-world manipulation, yet their performance often saturates when training data are naively pooled across heterogeneous robots, tasks, and environments. Distributionally robust data mixture optimization, exemplified by Re-Mix, can recover much of this performance, but its weight search requires training full-scale policies twice on the entire corpus, placing it out of reach for most laboratories. We present ProMix, a compute-efficient instantiation of the proxy-reference DRO recipe for robotic imitation learning: a 15M-parameter proxy learns per-domain sampling weights by minimizing worst-case excess loss against a frozen reference model, and the learned weights transfer, without re-tuning, to VLA backbones up to 7B parameters. We further provide, to our knowledge, the first controlled analysis of the reference model's role in robotic DRO, showing that removing it induces over-pessimism toward noisy, low-quality domains (-3.8% average and -14.3% worst-domain success rate), and that entropy regularization is needed to prevent weight collapse. Evaluated on 9500 real-world episodes from the Open-X Embodiment dataset, ProMix improves the average success rate over uniform mixing from 68.4% to 76.2%, matching Re-Mix within evaluation noise while reducing mixture-optimization cost to a backbone-independent 11 GPU-hours - versus 16 GPU-hours at the 50M comparison scale and 192 GPU-hours at 7B for full-scale searches - with a +17.1% absolute gain on the worst-case domain.

AI.tldr: ProMix 用 15M 参数的小代理模型学习各数据域的采样权重，再把权重免调参迁移到最大 7B 的 VLA 主干上，从而以远低于 Re-Mix 的算力提升机器人模仿学习的数据混合效果。在 Open-X Embodiment 的 9500 条真实世界片段上，平均成功率由均匀混合的 68.4% 提升到 76.2%，混合优化成本为与主干无关的 11 GPU-hours。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，VLA 模型在异构机器人、任务与环境数据被朴素混合时性能常趋于饱和；分布鲁棒的数据混合优化（如 Re-Mix）能挽回大部分性能，但其权重搜索需要在全量语料上完整训练两次全规模策略，对多数实验室而言算力门槛过高。ProMix 针对的正是这一"有效但太贵"的缺口。
AI.method: 输入是多域异构的机器人模仿学习数据（按域划分）与一个冻结的参考模型。方法训练一个 15M 参数的代理模型，按域最小化"最坏情况超额损失"（相对冻结参考模型的 excess loss）来学出每个域的采样权重，并用熵正则化防止权重坍塌；产出的是一组域级采样权重，这些权重无需重新调参即可直接用于最大 7B 参数的 VLA 主干训练。与 Re-Mix 的差别在于：权重搜索不再需要对全规模策略做两次全语料训练，而是在小代理上完成，因此成本与主干规模解耦。摘要还给出了首个关于参考模型在机器人 DRO 中作用的受控分析。
AI.result: 实验条件为 Open-X Embodiment 数据集的 9500 条真实世界片段，基线为均匀混合，对照为 Re-Mix。平均成功率从 68.4% 提升到 76.2%，作者称与 Re-Mix 在评测噪声内相当（摘要未给出噪声幅度）。最坏域上作者报告 +17.1% 的绝对增益。混合优化成本降至与主干无关的 11 GPU-hours，对比 50M 比较规模下的 16 GPU-hours 与 7B 全规模搜索的 192 GPU-hours。消融方面，作者称去掉参考模型会导致对噪声、低质量域的过度悲观，平均成功率 -3.8%、最坏域成功率 -14.3%，并指出需要熵正则化来避免权重坍塌。以上均为作者自报结果，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：数据混合优化可以从"必须重训大模型"变成"小代理上学权重、大模型上直接用"，使分布鲁棒的数据配方在算力有限时也可行，并且摘要显示其在真实世界机器人数据上不牺牲平均性能。但证据边界明确——全部结果来自摘要所述的 Open-X 真实世界片段与 VLA 模仿学习设定，未报告统计显著性、逐域明细或超出该数据集与 ≤7B 主干的泛化验证，因此"可迁移到更大主干或其他机器人形态"尚不能由摘要支持。

title: MAWAM: Joint Imagination for Collaborative Robot Manipulation with a Multi-Agent World Action Model
summary: World action models (WAMs) excel at robot manipulation by imagining future observations and decoding actions from them, yet remain confined to a single embodied agent. In practice, manipulation often requires multiple robots to collaborate across disjoint workspaces, coupled timing, and heterogeneous embodiments. Such coordination demands both spatiotemporal alignment of future interactions and awareness of individual embodiment and role identities, whereas existing decentralized per-robot policies, flat centralized models, and multi-robot VLAs fail to unite both. To bridge this gap, we present MAWAM, a multi-agent world action model that jointly predicts the future observations of multiple embodiments and decodes each agent's actions from them for collaborative manipulation. Through an agent-axis curriculum, MAWAM expands a single-agent WAM along an agent dimension to coordinate teams under shared weights. Within one unified causal sequence, joint self-attention spans all agents to spatiotemporally align their imagined futures, while hierarchical language, identity encodings, and embodiment masks bind each stream to its role, identity, and embodiment. We further formalize multi-agent-necessary manipulation along three axes (why, when, and who) and develop MA-Task Harness, a coding-agent pipeline where mutually constraining generators and evaluators co-evolve customizable simulation-data and evaluation packages. Using this pipeline, we build MA-Bench across all axes with seven tasks, pairing joint success rate with role and collaboration scores for fine-grained analysis. On MA-Bench, MAWAM reaches 82.7% mean joint success, 30.7% above the strongest baseline, and achieves real-time closed-loop collaboration on a real heterogeneous robot team.

title: HERO: Hierarchical Region-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Exploration
summary: Autonomous exploration is widely used to map unknown environments, yet maintaining both path efficiency and low online computation remains difficult as environment scale increases. Hierarchical planners reduce global search through coarse regional representations but often rely on handcrafted local viewpoint-selection rules. Graph-based reinforcement learning can improve local decisions, but its inference cost grows with the exploration graph and global direction is usually represented only implicitly. To address these limitations, we present HERO, a hierarchical framework that assigns distinct responsibilities to global planning and learned local decision-making, enabling each level to focus on the function it is best suited to perform. To reduce the growing inference cost of graph-based policies, HERO restricts learned target selection to reachable candidates within the current region while using region-level planning to provide long-horizon guidance. To avoid informative targets causing excessive deviation from this global direction, the proposed Dual-Branch Graph Policy balances Frontier Utility with guidance toward the next region, improving both local exploration and global progress. Experiments on unseen 2D maps show the lowest overall mean path length and target-decision cost among the evaluated methods. MARSIM simulations and deployments at three real-world sites further demonstrate the framework's applicability with LiDAR-based mapping and chassis dynamics.

title: RoboLiveMem: Is Robot Memory Solved When the World Does Not Wait?
summary: Robot agents built on frontier vision-language models now solve most robot memory benchmarks. Does this mean they can remember what they need in a home, where people and machines keep moving things? Existing memory benchmarks cannot answer this question, because they pause the simulator while the model thinks: nothing can change during a decision, so whatever the robot remembers is still true when it acts. We introduce RoboLiveMem, a benchmark that runs the same memory tasks twice, once with the world paused while the model thinks and once with the world running. It contains 29 task families in three tiers, from 16 realistic BEHAVIOR-1K scenes of homes, workshops and a restaurant to controlled ManiSkill tasks. Every task mixes real changes with harmless look-alikes and runs without any change, so that no fixed strategy succeeds, and most tasks have a twin that keeps the change in view, which separates forgetting from acting too late. Testing 16 models on 34,176 episodes, we find three surprises. (1) Paused results hide the problem: when a remembered object changes in a realistic scene, the 8 Claude and GPT models succeed in 97% of episodes on average with the world paused, but in only 50% with the world running, and their ranking changes: Claude Opus 5.5, which never fails when paused, succeeds in 44%. (2) Speed is not the fix: slower models do no worse, and models given only 2 s per decision still fall at least 36 points below their paused success. (3) Models see the change but act on camera frames from before it ended. Looking again just before acting closes most of the realistic gap, yet when identical objects are swapped several times, all nine models we test still lose points to memory.

title: FlexWAM: Learning Flexible Visual Routing for World Action Models
summary: Humans dynamically adjust their reliance on sensory modalities across manipulation stages. Although existing World Action Models (WAMs) fuse multi-camera observations, they struggle to adapt their reliance on individual views based on the current observations. This raises a central question: how can the action expert integrate complementary visual evidence while prioritizing the views most relevant to the current action? FlexWAM addresses this challenge through three modules. First, we alternate within-view and cross-view attention to capture view-specific dynamics and complementary cues. For action prediction, View-Routed Action Attention uses an observation-conditioned router to prioritize relevant views. To calibrate routing, we train a critic using counterfactual view credit, estimated from action loss sensitivity upon suppressing each view's contribution to action attention. We evaluate FlexWAM with two video backbones on five challenging real-world manipulation tasks across two robot platforms. The two variants improve mean task success by 16.4 and 23.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 现有世界动作模型(WAM)虽融合多相机观测，却无法依据当前观测自适应调整对各视角的依赖。FlexWAM 用交替的视角内/跨视角注意力、观测条件化的视角路由动作注意力，以及由反事实视角信用训练的 critic 来校准路由；作者报告在两个视频 backbone、两个机器人平台、五个真实操作任务上，两个变体的平均任务成功率比最强基线分别提升 16.4 与 23.0 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 人类在不同操作阶段会动态调整对各感官模态的依赖；而现有 WAM 融合多相机观测时，难以根据当前观测改变对单个视角的依赖程度。因此作者提出核心问题：动作专家如何在整合互补视觉证据的同时，优先使用与当前动作最相关的视角。

title: Spiking World-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict how the world responds to actions and offer a promising path toward general embodied intelligence, but they are large and run the network many times per plan, so they are hard to deploy on robots. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) compute with sparse binary spikes and use additions instead of multiplications, which saves power. However, existing WAMs use dense videos as the world state, so a spiking version would spend most of its computation on the background. We therefore introduce SpikingWAM, the first spiking WAM, which uses a sparse task skeleton as the world state. Inspired by biological motor control, which attends only to the key positions of a task, the Task Skeleton State (TSS) keeps the keypoints of the arm and the task objects, and a small spiking front end estimates the object keypoints from images. Body Frame Spike Coding (BFSC) and Grid Coincidence Attention (GCA) keep millimetre precision, and the Persistent Single Step Readout (PSR) runs the network once per plan. On the simulated benchmarks LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, SpikingWAM achieves competitive success rates with far less energy than ANN methods and surpasses all compared methods on LIBERO-Plus. Real robot experiments further confirm its effectiveness. These results show that a task skeleton lets spiking networks implement WAMs at very low energy, offering a new solution for low power embodied intelligence. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 为把世界动作模型（WAM）部署到机器人上，作者提出首个脉冲 WAM——SpikingWAM：用稀疏任务骨架替代稠密视频作为世界状态，并让网络每次规划只前向一次；作者报告在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 仿真上成功率有竞争力、能耗远低于 ANN 方法，且在 LIBERO-Plus 上超过所有对比方法，摘要未给出任何数值。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型能预测世界如何响应动作，但是大、每次规划要多次运行网络，难以部署到机器人上。脉冲网络用稀疏二值脉冲、以加法替代乘法来省电，然而已有 WAM 以稠密视频作为世界状态，脉冲化后大部分计算会消耗在背景上。

title: SuperNav-1.5: Structured Spatial Memory For Agentic Navigation Systems
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of scene-level memory design for efficient navigation across sessions and successive object goals. Recent methods commonly represent a scene using scene graphs or image--text records. However, dense scene-graph representations impose substantial reasoning and context overhead on multimodal large language models, while image--text records cannot be directly converted into executable geometric routes. To address these limitations, we propose SuperNav-1.5, an agentic navigation system equipped with a structured spatial memory constructed by the agent. The memory consists of an area-segmented occupancy map annotated with agent-maintained, map-grounded memory nodes. This map guides the agent toward unvisited areas and provides executable routes to known locations. For multi-session navigation, we introduce agent-guided relocalization, whereby the agent infers an area prior from current observations and stored memory records to constrain geometric matching and localize the robot within the stored map. Together, these designs enable efficient navigation across session and successive object goals. Experiments show that our method outperforms baselines on single-object, multi-object, and demand-driven navigation benchmarks, with particularly strong gains in path efficiency. Multi-session evaluation demonstrates that the constructed memory can be reused, while deployment on a real quadruped robot further shows the system's applicability.

title: MoMa-NMP: Scene-Scale Neural Motion Planning for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Mobile manipulators operating in homes and other complex environments must coordinate their base and arm over long horizons, navigating around obstacles, through narrow passages, and between constrained workspaces. Neural motion planners can provide fast closed-loop planning from partial observations, but scaling them to room-sized environments is difficult because generating high-quality training trajectories is itself a challenging motion-planning problem. To address this, we introduce MoMa-DemoSmith, a demonstration-generation pipeline that separates the problem into global path discovery for large complex scenes and local motion refinement for collision avoidance. This key separation enables the generation of millions of challenging whole-body trajectories across our procedurally generated scenes. We train MoMa-NMP on these demonstrations through behavior cloning (BC) followed by privileged on-policy distillation, achieving 87.0% success on our simulation benchmark and 77.5% across 80 trials in unseen real-world scenes. See video results at this https URL .

title: PushMimic: Learning Adaptive Humanoid Box Pushing via Dynamic Motion Augmentation and Reference Distillation
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Website at this https URL
summary: Humanoid box pushing is challenging when the physical properties of the task, such as the box mass and the ramp inclination, are unknown before the push begins. This paper presents PushMimic, a framework that learns adaptive humanoid box pushing from a single level-ground kinematic reference motion. The learned policy adapts its pushing posture to these properties without observing them. PushMimic augments the reference motion into a dynamically feasible motion dataset over these properties with sampling-based trajectory optimization, and distills the dataset into one motion tracking policy in one stage of training. Simulation results over box masses from 5 to 15 kg and ramp inclinations up to 15 degrees show that PushMimic raises the success rate from 57.8% to 88.8% compared with a baseline that tracks the original reference motion. It also reduces the cost of push of the arms by 22%. Hardware experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that the policy adapts its torso pitch during continuous pushing on an inclined treadmill, with box masses up to 19 kg and ramp inclinations up to 12.6 degrees. PushMimic therefore needs only one reference motion, instead of one for every box mass and ramp inclination.

AI.tldr: PushMimic 用采样轨迹优化把单条平地基线参考动作扩展成覆盖不同箱体质量与坡度的动态可行动作数据集，再一步蒸馏为一个动作跟踪策略，使策略在不观测物理属性的情况下自适应推箱姿态。仿真中成功率从 57.8% 提升到 88.8%（对比跟踪原始参考动作的基线），并降低手臂推动代价 22%。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人推箱的困难在于推动开始前箱体质量与坡面倾角等物理属性未知。作者指出，常规做法可能需要为每种箱体质量和坡度各准备一条参考动作；本文的动机是用单一平地参考动作替代这种逐条件参考动作的做法。
AI.method: 输入是一条平地（level-ground）运动学参考动作，以及待覆盖的物理属性范围（箱体质量、坡面倾角）。方法不改变参考动作本身，而是用基于采样的轨迹优化把这条参考动作扩展成一个在这些属性上动态可行的动作数据集；随后在一次训练阶段中把该数据集蒸馏成单个动作跟踪策略。输出是一个不观测箱体质量和坡度的推箱策略，其推箱姿态会随这些未观测属性自适应变化。相对基线（直接跟踪原始参考动作）的变化在于：参考动作由一条变为覆盖属性范围的数据集，且蒸馏被压缩在一个训练阶段内。
AI.result: 作者报告：在箱体质量 5 至 15 kg、坡面倾角最高 15 度的仿真设置下，成功率由 57.8% 提升至 88.8%，对照基线是跟踪原始参考动作的策略；同时手臂推动代价降低 22%。硬件实验在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行，作者报告策略在倾斜跑道上连续推箱时会调整躯干俯仰，箱体质量最高 19 kg、坡面倾角最高 12.6 度；摘要未报告硬件实验的定量成功率或与基线的硬件对比。摘要未报告统计显著性、试验次数与消融实验。
AI.conclusion: 对人形操作与运动而言，该工作的意义在于把"为每种任务物理属性各配一条参考动作"改为"用一条参考动作经动态增广后蒸馏出单个自适应策略"，从而在属性推动前不可观测时仍能完成推箱。证据边界：定量增益（57.8%→88.8%、手臂代价 −22%）仅来自摘要所述的仿真设置；硬件部分摘要只描述了躯干俯仰的自适应行为与最高 19 kg、12.6 度的条件，未给出数值成功率，因此不能据此推断真实机器人的成功率水平或相对基线的优势。
AI.core_method: 用采样轨迹优化把一条平地参考动作增广为覆盖不同箱体质量与坡度的动态可行动作数据集，再一步蒸馏成单个动作跟踪策略。

key_results.setting: 仿真；箱体质量 5–15 kg，坡面倾角最高 15 度；基线为跟踪原始参考动作。
key_results.evidence_quote: Simulation results over box masses from 5 to 15 kg and ramp inclinations up to 15 degrees show that PushMimic raises the success rate from 57.8% to 88.8% compared with a baseline that tracks the original reference motion.

title: MotionServe: Efficient Multi-Robot Serving by Exploiting Robot Execution Slack
summary: As robotic arms undertake diverse manipulation tasks, a deployment may need to serve many task-specific vision-language-action (VLA) policies concurrently. Dedicating a GPU to each robot is costly, motivating shared-GPU inference. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) allows compatible policies to share a frozen backbone with lightweight policy-specific adapters, reducing model-weight memory and enabling cross-policy batching. However, robot inference must keep pace with physical execution. With action chunking, robots continue executing buffered actions while awaiting new predictions, and the remaining buffered time provides each robot's execution slack for serving its next request. Once this slack is exhausted, the robot stalls until new actions arrive, interrupting task progress. Observing earlier preserves more slack but can lead to disruptive replanning and lower task success, whereas delaying dispatch to form larger batches can improve GPU efficiency but consumes slack and risks stalls. To balance these competing demands, we present MotionServe, a shared-GPU serving system that coordinates robot observation timing with server-side batch formation. MotionExec selects observation triggers based on motion structure in predicted action chunks, allowing inference to overlap with remaining buffered execution. SlackBatch combines the resulting per-robot execution budgets with estimated outstanding GPU work to determine when to wait, which requests to batch, and when to dispatch them. We evaluate X-VLA on LIBERO and SimplerEnv's WidowX tasks and OpenVLA-OFT on LIBERO, with up to 96 simulated robots sharing one NVIDIA H200 GPU. At 96 robots, MotionServe reduces mean stall per episode by 43.4% and 32.6% and improves task success by 8.98 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively, over each model's lowest-stall baseline. Backbone sharing also reduces weight memory for 96 policies by 97.6% and 91.1%.

AI.tldr: MotionServe 面向多机器人共享 GPU 的 VLA 策略服务：把动作分块带来的执行余量用于协调观测时机与批处理，从而减少机器人等待并提升任务成功率。作者在最多 96 个模拟机器人共享一块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 的设定下报告 stall 下降和成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 机器人部署可能需同时服务多个任务专用 VLA 策略，为每台机器人独占 GPU 成本高，因此需要共享 GPU 推理。机器人推理又必须跟上物理执行节奏；动作分块下机器人可继续执行缓存动作，剩余缓存时间形成执行余量。观测太早虽保留更多余量，却可能引发破坏性重规划并降低任务成功率；为凑大批次而延迟下发虽提升 GPU 效率，却消耗余量并增加 stall 风险。
AI.method: 输入是多台机器人上的任务专用 VLA 策略及其动作分块执行状态；系统让兼容策略共享冻结主干，仅用轻量 LoRA 适配器承载策略差异，并支持跨策略批处理。MotionServe 由两部分组成：MotionExec 根据预测动作块中的运动结构选择观测触发时机，使推理与剩余缓存执行重叠；SlackBatch 结合每台机器人剩余执行预算与估计的未完成 GPU 工作量，决定何时等待、批哪些请求以及何时下发。输出是共享 GPU 上的调度与批量推理安排，目标是在不打断任务推进的前提下平衡及时观测与批量效率。
AI.result: 评测覆盖 X-VLA（LIBERO 与 SimplerEnv 的 WidowX 任务）和 OpenVLA-OFT（LIBERO），最多 96 个模拟机器人共享一块 NVIDIA H200 GPU。作者报告在 96 台机器人时，相对各模型的最低 stall 基线，每 episode 平均 stall 降低 43.4% 与 32.6%（相对百分比），任务成功率提升 8.98 与 2.30 个百分点；同时，主干共享使 96 个策略的权重内存降低 97.6% 与 91.1%。摘要称这些比较对象是“各模型的最低 stall 基线”，但未给出该基线的具体构成。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能系统而言，该工作提示可把动作分块执行期间的剩余时间作为调度资源，在共享 GPU 上服务多个 VLA 策略，而非为每台机器人独占 GPU。证据限于作者在最多 96 个模拟机器人和单块 H200 上的报告，摘要未报告真实机器人部署、统计显著性、完整基线定义或延迟/能耗指标，因此结论应被视为该设定下的作者报告结果。
AI.core_method: 用预测动作块的剩余执行余量来安排观测触发与共享 GPU 批量下发，让多机器人 VLA 推理尽量与物理执行重叠。

key_results.finding: 在 96 台机器人时，相对各模型的最低 stall 基线，每 episode 平均 stall 降低 43.4% 与 32.6%（相对百分比），任务成功率提升 8.98 与 2.30 个百分点。
key_results.setting: 最多 96 个模拟机器人共享一块 NVIDIA H200 GPU；模型为 X-VLA（LIBERO 与 SimplerEnv 的 WidowX 任务）和 OpenVLA-OFT（LIBERO）；基线为各模型的最低 stall 基线；摘要未报告真实机器人实验。
key_results.evidence_quote: At 96 robots, MotionServe reduces mean stall per episode by 43.4% and 32.6% and improves task success by 8.98 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively, over each model's lowest-stall baseline.

key_results.finding: 主干共享使 96 个策略的权重内存降低 97.6% 与 91.1%。
key_results.setting: 96 个策略共享冻结主干与 LoRA 适配器的场景；摘要未报告测量条件、内存基线和具体硬件配置细节。
key_results.evidence_quote: Backbone sharing also reduces weight memory for 96 policies by 97.6% and 91.1%.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者明确列出的局限性。
摘要只报告最多 96 个模拟机器人共享一块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 的结果，未报告真实机器人部署或真实硬件实验。
